question: What is the name of the northern part of the western coastal plain between Mumbai and Goa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Konkan coast**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The northern part of the western coastal plain between Mumbai and Goa is known as the **Konkan coast**.
 
• The Konkan coast is renowned for its scenic beauty, comprising long stretches of beaches, cliffs, and lush greenery.
 
• It is a significant region for tourism in India, attracting visitors to its picturesque landscapes and historical sites.
 
• Other coastal regions in India include the **Coromandel coast** along the southeastern coast and the **Malabar coast** along the southwestern coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Coromandel coast** lies along the eastern coast of India, stretching from Tamil Nadu to Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The **Malabar coast** is located along the southwestern coast, extending from Kerala to Karnataka.
 
• The **Kannad plain** is part of the Deccan plateau in southern India, not a coastal region.
 
• India's coastline is divided into distinct regions, each with its unique geographical and cultural characteristics.
